page_title: NAP 2-1 SAL | Napoli v Salernitana 13/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The match has just finished.
90+10' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90+6' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
90+6' 2 - 1 Goal! Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.
90+5' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) has tested the patience of referee Livio Marinelli and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) comes onto the pitch so that Simy can be given a rest.
90+1' Here is a change. Junior Sambia is going off and Filippo Inzaghi gives the last tactical orders to Dylan Bronn (Salernitana).
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' The corner is swung in but Napoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
87' A cross into the box from Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is cleared.
85' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Napoli comes to nothing.
84' Substitution. Flavius Daniliuc (Salernitana) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Norbert Gyomber walks off.
81' Napoli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
79' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
77' Walter Mazzarri is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Jens Cajuste suffers an injury and Diego Demme (Napoli) comes on.
75' Jens Cajuste (Napoli) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
73' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
71' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Napoli.
70' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
67' It looks like Juan Jesus (Napoli) saw red with that tackle. Livio Marinelli won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
66' Filippo Inzaghi has decided to substitute Mateusz Legowski and he is replaced by Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana).
66' Today's match ends for Matteo Politano who will be replaced by Alessio Zerbin (Napoli).
65' The corner kick from Mario Rui (Napoli) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
65' An attempted cross from Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) is cleared. It will be a corner kick for Napoli.
63' The shots on goal statistics – 3:2.
61' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
59' Matteo Politano (Napoli) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
57' Salernitana failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
56' Here comes a substitution. Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) is brought on as a substitute for Gianluca Gaetano.
56' The resulting set piece from Salernitana is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
55' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
55' Salernitana work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
53' Mario Rui (Napoli) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
50' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Junior Sambia (Salernitana).
48' Napoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
47' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
46' Referee Livio Marinelli blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+88' Livio Marinelli shows a yellow card to Filippo Inzaghi (Salernitana) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+4' 1 - 1 Goal! Matteo Politano (Napoli) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Guillermo Ochoa into the bottom left corner.
45+4' Matteo Politano (Napoli) is going to take the penalty!
45+3' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!

45+2' Play continues despite the shouts by some Napoli players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Livio Marinelli interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
45+1' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
43' Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
41' Gianluca Gaetano (Napoli) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
39' Jens Cajuste (Napoli) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
37' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Agustin Martegani (Salernitana) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
34' Jens Cajuste (Napoli) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
32' Mario Rui (Napoli) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
29' 0 - 1 GOAL! Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) receives a quality pass, makes a yard for himself and smashes a jaw-dropping long-range shot into the top right corner. What a remarkable goal!
25' Napoli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
23' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
21' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
19' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
17' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Livio Marinelli no option but to blow his whistle.
15' Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
13' Gianluca Gaetano (Napoli) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
11' Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
9' The corner is swung in but Napoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
7' Napoli are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
5' The ball is out of play. Napoli will have a throw-in.
3' A lofted cross from Gianluca Gaetano (Napoli) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Napoli will kick-off.
Livio Marinelli is introduced as the referee for today's match.
